title: Compiled engine program (plan §8.2; atlas docs/atlas/engine-program.md)
description: Hand-authored background card-advantage engine — two pieces on the battlefield, one gated cycle per turn, NO exit state. Consumed by EngineProgramRunner. Reverse-engineered from the working set (widen to reality, plan §6); the load-bearing fields are the setup casts and the per-turn cycle.

engine_id.description: MUST equal the filename id (engine-program-<id>.json), typically ep-*.

compiled_from.description: Provenance — script_hashes + an oracle_cross_check that states WHY stock fails to run the engine, plus the load_bearing_interaction. Free-form.

setup.description: Which pieces to cast and when ({action:'cast', card, frequency, priority}).

cycle.description: The per-turn activation: frequency + gates[] (all must hold, incl. the load-bearing live condition) + action{activate,cost}.

on_interruption.description: An engine has no exit state — typically idle_and_retry.
